resources.string: Works around a Xiaomi TV bug: in the Bluetooth pairing request dialog the remote\'s OK button presses \"Pair\". Does nothing on any other screen.
In the \"Bluetooth pairing request\" dialog the remote\'s OK button now presses \"Pair\". BACK cancels pairing.\n\nThe fix works on its own, you can close this app.
One step left: turn the fix on

Android does not let an app switch this on by itself, so please do it once:

1. Press "Open settings".
2. Under "Services", select "Bluetooth pairing: remote OK fix".
3. Turn it on and confirm with OK.
4. Press BACK to return here.
If the switch is greyed out: Settings → Apps → Bluetooth pairing: remote OK fix → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Settings did not open. Go to Settings → Device Preferences → Accessibility manually.
